payload.tension: The passage states 1 Corinthians 15:43–47 places spirit language at the boundary of life and death, where it gives life; the immediate wording centers on “The first man Adam became a living soul. The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
